description: Read whether this channel has ever been onboarded and whether its agent has ever been activated, as {onboarded, activated_once}. Known limitation: this is NOT a Meta call - it reads this service's own tracking record, written when onboarding or a settings read/write goes through here. It answers 'did onboarding ever succeed' and 'was rollout ever enabled', and nothing about the agent's current configuration. For live state call mba_get_agent_settings.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_agent_state
title: Read agent state
